name: FLUX 3 Image Klein Base

lineage.how_derived: undistilled base checkpoint of FLUX 3 Image Klein; the distilled checkpoint (16 steps, no guidance) is the separate record flux3-image-klein

purpose: Undistilled base checkpoint for fine-tuning, LoRA training and research; same capabilities as Klein (editing, text-to-image, composition from up to 10 reference images, optional bounding-box layout). Uses classifier-free guidance (50 steps, guidance 3.5 per the card as summarized).

license.name: FLUX Kommunity License v1.0 (text encoder Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct: Apache-2.0)
license.notes: The card (read through a summarizing fetch, repo is gated) names the same license as the distilled Klein: non-commercial use, and commercial output generation only for Qualifying Users under US$5M annual revenue. The license text itself was read for the sibling record flux3-image-klein (unsloth copy), not for this repo, hence verified false. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: diffusion transformer, dense, undistilled; separate text encoder Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct; separate 9B prompt upsampler
architecture.why_this_design: Card says to always run the prompt upsampler because short prompts give generic output (summarized).

variants.format: safetensors BF16 (transformer 11.08 GB, text encoder 8.89 GB, VAE 0.34 GB)
variants.notes: gated; repo total 43.24 GB includes the FP8 and NVFP4 variants and a root model.safetensors (11.08 GB) of the same size as the transformer/ folder (likely a second copy, not compared). FP8 (variants/fp8r) transformer 6.25 GB, NVFP4 (variants/nvfp4) 5.26 GB. Card: peak GPU memory on a B200 at 1024x1024 without the upsampler about 31 GB BF16, 29 GB FP8, 26 GB NVFP4.

pc-12gb.variant: NVFP4 / FP8 transformer with text encoder offloaded
pc-12gb.notes: the card's 26-31 GB peak figures are B200 measurements with everything resident; offload is needed. Fine-tuning use needs far more.

pc-16gb.notes: inference with offload; training not realistic

weaknesses: License limits commercial use above US$5M revenue
No benchmarks on the card; 50 steps with guidance makes it slower than the distilled Klein for plain generation
soft.maturity: Black Forest Labs; about 69k downloads in the last month on the page read.

tona_fit.reason: A training base, not an inference default: the distilled Klein generates in 16 steps without guidance and is the one to offer. Relevant only if Tona users want to train LoRAs for the image path.
blockers: Tona has no image engine and no training path
